_meta.note: Editorial descriptions only. Amounts always come from program data. Exact InvestIN price matches identify otherwise unlabelled packages; unmatched prices keep their original labels. Sources describe inclusions, not confirmation of a catalogue price for a new season.

residentialNote.en: A refundable €70 residence deposit is payable on arrival, in addition to the package fee.
residentialNote.tr: Paket ücretine ek olarak varışta iade edilebilir €70 yurt depozitosu ödenir.

note.en: 2026 reference fees. Return airport transfers are required for students under 18 and charged separately. Future prices and availability require confirmation.
note.tr: 2026 referans ücretleri. 18 yaş altı öğrenciler için gidiş-dönüş havalimanı transferi zorunludur ve ayrıca ücretlendirilir. Yeni dönem ücretleri ve kontenjanı teyit edilmelidir.
